column1: # A function's file named by another build of the same source, where the 1.14d Intel binary has no
# __FILE__ for it. Read by coverage.ts: inside an `anchors` unit such a row anchors like the function's own
# literal, so it names its file and brackets the functions between it and an anchor of the same file.
# Searched and how each source is read: coverage/path-evidence.md.
# addr      the clean Mac program's address
# file      below Diablo2/Source, with the Mac folder names' spaces (as units.tsv)
# source    ppc-storm   the PPC Storm shared library (CodeWarrior, traceback-table names): the function of
#                       the same name references the file's __FILE__ (own), or lies between two of that
#                       file's __FILE__ users or its __sinit_<file> (bracket), in both the 1.13d classic Storm
#           ppc-shell   the PPC 1.10 Beta Carbon game (no traceback names): the one function holding the
#                       same unique strings as the Mac function pushes the file's __FILE__ in its body
#           fossil      the Windows 1.07 (JP) D2OpenGL.dll, whose COFF table names every function
#                       (MSVC-decorated): the function of the interface slot the Mac function fills
#                       (docs/data/mac-only-proposals.tsv kind fossil-name, high) pushes the file's
#                       __FILE__ (own), or lies between two of its users (bracket)
# evidence  the addresses and strings, re-checkable from the binaries
